svg.title: Proof. If functionals Aν ∈E∗ D and values bν satisfy P cνAν = 0 ⇒P cνbν = 0, then Aν 7→bν is a well-defined linear functional on the span, extends to E∗ D and is represented by an element of E∗∗ D = ED; faithfulness of the quotient (Theorem 18.3) makes the class unique and gives linearity. Generic grid configurations are used first and translation and continuity extend to all separated configurations. For the face flux multiply the current by 1 −χ with χ supported strictly inside the box: it is smooth on the box with divergence −P a ∂aχFa, the divergence theorem applies, and χ = 0 on every face.
